name: Pull requests
description: The repository's open pull requests beside Diff and Files: what waits on your review, how your own are doing, and an agent to review one or fix it in a click. Needs the GitHub CLI, signed in.

statusItems.label: Pull requests to review
statusItems.command: n=$(gh pr list --search 'review-requested:@me' --json number --jq length) && if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then printf ' %s to review\nPull requests waiting on your review. Click to see them.\n' "$n"; fi
